draft_notes.author: host
draft_notes.explanation: Group pixels by unique object colour. Translate each object along the specialized alignment axis so its bounding-box minimum aligns with that of the palette[8] anchor. Since objects share one shape and extent, this also works with reversed axes. Distinct orthogonal spans prevent collisions.

draft_notes.limitations: Constructor requires unique nonbackground object colours, shared shape and nonoverlapping orthogonal bounding intervals. Alignment-axis specialization must be evident in demos, checked by dataset augmentation disambiguation.
